nodes.name: Linear: tickets last 7d (mock if no key)

parameters.jsCode:
// Build the prompt that will be sent to Claude.
const data = $json.aggregated;

const linearBlock = data.linear === null
  ? "(Linear data unavailable — no LINEAR_API_KEY configured. Use placeholder examples.)"
  : JSON.stringify(data.linear, null, 2);

const slackBlock = data.slack === null
  ? "(Slack data unavailable — no SLACK_BOT_TOKEN configured. Use placeholder examples.)"
  : JSON.stringify(data.slack.slice(0, 20), null, 2);

const userPrompt = `You are a senior engineering manager writing a weekly development summary for the team.

Period: ${data.week}

## Data from the last 7 days

### GitHub (repo: ${data.sources_status.github})
PRs total: ${data.github.prs_total} (merged: ${data.github.prs_merged}, open: ${data.github.prs_open}, closed-not-merged: ${data.github.prs_closed})
Issues total: ${data.github.issues_total} (opened this week: ${data.github.issues_opened}, closed: ${data.github.issues_closed})

Pull requests:
${data.github.prs.map(p => `- #${p.number} [${p.merged ? 'merged' : p.state}] ${p.title} (by @${p.user})`).join('\n')}

Issues:
${data.github.issues.map(i => `- #${i.number} [${i.state}] ${i.title} (by @${i.user}, labels: ${i.labels.join(', ') || 'none'})`).join('\n')}

### Linear (${data.sources_status.linear})
${linearBlock}

### Slack #dev (${data.sources_status.slack})
${slackBlock}

## Your task

Produce a structured Markdown summary with EXACTLY these sections:

# Weekly Dev Summary — ${data.week}

## 🚀 Highlights
- 3-5 bullet points of the most important things that happened this week.

## 🔀 Pull Requests
- Group by status (Merged / Open / Closed). For each, give: #N short title (link).

## 🐛 Issues
- Group by status. Mention notable labels.

## 🎫 Linear/Jira Tickets
- List completed and in-progress tickets. If data is unavailable, write a short note explaining the limitation.

## 💬 Slack #dev Pulse
- Top themes discussed. If data is unavailable, write a short note.

## 📊 Numbers
- A small table: PRs merged, PRs open, Issues opened, Issues closed, Tickets completed (if known).

## ⚠️ Risks & Blockers
- Anything the team should be aware of going into next week.

## 🎯 Suggested Next-Week Focus
- 2-4 concrete recommendations.

Rules:
- Be concise. Total length under 600 words.
- Use GitHub-style markdown that renders in GitHub Issues.
- If a data source is unavailable, say so explicitly — do not invent numbers.
- Tone: professional, friendly, no fluff.`;

return [{
  json: {
    prompt: userPrompt,
    week_label: $json._week_label,
    github_owner: $json._github_owner,
    github_repo: $json._github_repo,
    github_target_repo: $json._github_target_repo
  }
}];

meta.description: Automated weekly development activity summary powered by Claude (claude-3-5-sonnet-latest). Collects GitHub PRs/issues, Linear tickets, and Slack #dev messages for the last 7 days, then publishes a structured markdown digest to GitHub Issues, Slack, and/or email.
